window_selection.criterion: Mean of six methods: equal-weight mean F1 across six basic scenarios. Tie: lower normal FPR, then shorter window.
limitations: Best among these six candidates on this validation generator, not a universal optimum.
Final benchmark was already evaluated in v1, so it is not a newly blind external test.
Quarter source-template holdout is hash-based, not a future chronological validation split.
Prior traffic history and episodes are synthetic; original patterns overlap final benchmark generation.
Incomplete early windows use available history; labels/decisions stay on the original minute grid.
Normal row comparison still uses its unchanged original reference protocol; window selection is separate.
Semi-synthetic stress test; original normal patterns overlap with evaluation generation.
New comparable research models, NOT the previously saved serving IF.
Window references are independently seeded normal replays with disjoint source workflows; virtual dates overlap across reference/test episodes.
TARGET windows assume a predefined monitored business group; production must monitor all groups, not select them using incident labels.
Event-time offline evaluation; delayed completed logs require an arrival stream or watermark policy for live traffic features.
Row evaluation excludes collective-only labels and cannot classify a zero-row input-stop event.
Precision uses zero_division=0; no positive ground truth makes Recall/F1 unavailable.
Hard all-six recall is reported separately; one event hit is not full case success.
